# Bar D Construction & Land Services

> Locally owned, family operated construction company in Stephenville, Texas (Erath County). Builds turnkey metal buildings ground up, converts shipping containers into livable space, works as a general contractor, and handles concrete, dirt work, fencing, riding arenas, land clearing, demolition, and roll-off dumpster rental within 75 miles of Stephenville.

## Facts

- Business name: Bar D Construction & Land Services
- Owner: Ryan Davidson
- Phone: (512) 525-6475
- Base: Stephenville, Texas, Erath County
- Service area: 75 miles in every direction from Stephenville
- Years: 12 years in the industry, 7+ years operating as Bar D
- Structure: locally owned and family operated; work executed through fully licensed and insured subcontractors coordinated by Bar D as the general contractor
- Recognition: nominated for Best of Erath 2026, Home and Services category
- Primary service: ground-up turnkey metal building construction (steel structure, welding, site work, foundation, and every licensed finish trade under one contract)
- Dumpster rental sizes: 11 yard, 15 yard, 18 yard roll-offs, delivered, picked up, and dumped; daily, weekly, or extended rental; same-day haul off and return; discounted pricing for multiple haul-offs
- Does not build swimming pools, though it does pour the concrete decking around them
- Quotes: free on every job, always. No pricing is published; every price is quoted after a site walk.
- Language: English
- Positioning in their own words: "No project is too big. No detail is too small." and "Quality work done right the first time."

## Six main services

1. **Metal Buildings** — shops, horse barns, carports, RV covers, commercial buildings, and interior finish-out including cedar stalls. Built turnkey from pad prep through finish trades.
2. **Container Modifications** — shipping containers cut, framed, insulated, and finished as livable space with covered decks, delivered serviced with water, power, AC, and heat.
3. **Dumpster Rental** — 11, 15, and 18 yard roll-offs, standalone or bundled with other work.
4. **Concrete & Dirt Work** — driveways, slabs, sidewalks, stamped and decorative decking, pool surrounds, retaining walls, building pad prep, grading, and drainage correction.
5. **Fencing & Arenas** — pipe fence, creosote post fence, ranch and field fence, gates, cattle guards, custom welded entrances, sorting pens, and riding arenas built from cleared ground to finished rail and lights.
6. **General Contracting** — ground-up builds, additions, and remodels with every licensed trade coordinated by Bar D. Also land clearing, demolition, drainage correction, welding and fabrication, and one-off specialty work.

## Documented builds on the site

Each of these is shown photographically at every stage, from bare ground to finished:

- **40' x 50' shop with covered patio** — drive and slab poured, steel set and welded, closed in with tan panel, Austin stone wainscot, and roll-up doors (Metal Buildings page)
- **Horse barn with stalls and wraparound covers** — posts set in open pasture through cedar stalls, concrete breezeway, and lighting (Metal Buildings page)
- **50' x 50' RV cover and covered patio** — pad and slab through finished open-span cover with a fifth wheel parked under it (Metal Buildings page)
- **Two-container weekend retreat** — two containers on a bluff turned into three private suites, a bunk room, kitchen, living area, covered porch, and overlook deck, with a walkthrough video (Container Modifications page)
- **Stamped concrete pool decking** — forms and steel on a slope through a finished continuous stamped pour (Concrete & Dirt Work page)
- **Riding arena** — cleared and graded ground through fencing, sorting pens, and arena lighting, with a before and after slider (Fencing & Arenas page)
